assessment: This important paper discloses a new control mechanism of meiotic crossing over, which is essential for the segregation of homologous chromosomes. With mathematical modeling and super-resolution imaging, the work provides convincing experimental data to support a model of "nucleoplasmic coarsening" between recombination intermediates and nucleoplasm for the control of crossover distribution in the context of a meiotic chromosome structure. The work will be of interest to researchers who work on meiosis as well as the regulation of chromosomal biology in general.
